name: render
description: Manage Render cloud infrastructure with Render's official MCP server: list workspaces and services, create web services, static sites, cron jobs, Postgres databases and Key Value stores, inspect deploys, read logs and metrics, update env vars, and run read-only SQL on Render Postgres.
author: Local developer
skillInstructions: Render's official hosted MCP server (https://mcp.render.com/mcp). Before first use, the user must connect it with a Render API key: Dashboard → Account Settings → API Keys → create a key, then connect the MCP server with Authorization: Bearer <key>. After connecting, first select the active Render workspace, then list services. Create/update operations are supported (create services and datastores, replace env vars), but the server does not delete services, trigger manual deploys, or change scaling — say so if asked.
